description: This file defines a UI component named 'FloatingCartButton' using LightningJS. It displays a floating shopping cart button with a badge showing the item count, and updates dynamically based on application state.

classes.name: FloatingCartButton
classes.description: A LightningJS component representing a floating cart button with a badge, including visual styling and state subscription.

methods.name: goCart
methods.description: Navigates the user to the '/cart' route when the button is activated.
